ruleDefinitions.name: CobaltStrike Load by Rundll32
ruleDefinitions.description: Rundll32 can be use by Cobalt Strike with StartW function to load DLLs from the command line.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "RUNDLL32\.EXE" OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*rundll32\\\.exe.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*rundll32\\ .*"))) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.dll.*") AND (process_command_line = RGX("\\ StartW$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\,StartW$"))))
